_note: Offline dictionary indices. Each entry serves one term language looked up in one definition language, because a Wiktextract extract carries glosses in the language of the Wiktionary edition it was extracted from. Downloaded on demand and installed locally; no network call is made to look a word up. The data is derived from Wiktionary, which is share-alike, so the licence and attribution fields are shown in the app.

dictionaries.name: Japanese to English
dictionaries.description: 145,000 Japanese headwords with English definitions, and 20,000 example sentences with translations. Built from the English Wiktionary edition.
dictionaries.attribution: Dictionary data from Wiktionary via Wiktextract (kaikki.org), CC BY-SA 4.0
